[RDSC.4.4] `compression` selects the codec applied to the
body. **`COMPRESSION_NONE` is the only supported codec:** the
compiler must emit `COMPRESSION_NONE` (bodies are stored
uncompressed), and the runtime carries no decompressor. A body
declaring any other codec is rejected with
`DS_ERR_DSC_DECOMPRESS` ([RDSC.4.5.1]).
